variables.name: ORACLE_HOST
variables.description: Oracle hostname. MUST stay the compose service name: Hop project variables OVERRIDE OS environment variables, so a value of 127.0.0.1 here silently defeats the ORACLE_HOST=oracle set by docker-compose and every container run fails with ORA-12541. Host-side runs (Hop GUI) override it through the 'local-gui' ENVIRONMENT (hop-env-local-gui.json), which is the only layer that wins over this default.
